name: audit-fixture-npm-aliases
_comment: Three aliases of `lodash` plus one alias of a scoped target (`@babel/code-frame`), alongside an unaliased `lodash` install. This stresses wrapper-segment handling with three aliases of the same target. Risk: hoisted's same-name handling might confuse the alias-target relationship — `node_modules/lodash-x` should contain lodash's contents (resolved through the alias) rather than try to install a non-existent npm package literally named `lodash-x`. Each alias gets its own root-level entry; isolated mode wraps each alias's identity into the wrappers tree (4 wrapper segments for 4 lodash-shaped surfaces); hoisted mode places each alias as its own top-level entry in the flat layout. Both must produce the same require() result for each alias.
